atoms.text: Mit dem conditional clause type 1 kann man beschreiben, unter welcher realistischen Bedingung ein bestimmtes Ereignis eintreffen wird.
atoms.sound: Mit dem <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>conditional clause type 1</voice> kann man beschreiben, unter welcher realistischen Bedingung ein bestimmtes Ereignis eintreffen wird. Im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>if-clause</voice> wird das <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>simple present</voice> verwendet und im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>main clause</voice> das <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>will future</voice> oder Modalverben.

example.a: If I <m-yellow>am</m-yellow> hungry before dinner, I <m-blue>will eat</m-blue> a banana.
example.b: Wenn ich vor dem Abendessen hungrig bin, werde ich eine Banane essen.
example.sound: If I am hungry before dinner, I will eat a banana.

b: ++If I see you on Monday, I will talk to you.
Will I see you on Monday?
I am going to talk to you when I see you on Monday.
++We will stay at home if the weather is bad.
Do you want to stay at home?
The weather will be bad tomorrow.
++I will miss him if he goes to college.
He will go to college and I will miss him.
Are you going to miss me when I go to college?

atoms.b: If I ((++travel will_travel)) to LA, I ((++will_see see)) the hollywood sign.
If Bekim ((++goes will_go)) to the cinema on the weekend, he ((will_buy buys)) popcorn.
If Amara ((++builds will_build)) a bird house, she ((might_see sees)) birds.
